description: This file defines an enumeration for HTTP status codes, providing mappings between status code integers and their symbolic names, along with utility methods for status code classification.

classes.name: HttpStatusCode
classes.description: Enumeration of HTTP status codes with associated integer values and utility methods for classification and lookup.

methods.name: forInt
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the HttpStatusCode matching the given integer, if it exists.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Returns the integer value of the status code.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the status code indicates a successful response (2XX).

methods.name: isClientError
methods.description: Checks if the status code indicates a client error (4XX).

methods.name: isInternalError
methods.description: Checks if the status code indicates a server error (5XX).
